title: SNJ Labs Private Ltd. — FDA Form 483 (실사 종료 2026-02-06)

evidence.quote: Your firm has inadequately written SOPs for raw material sample collection and in-process control samples that fail to provide sufficient instructions for QC personnel and operators.
